publisher: International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
title: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), 2023-24: India and State/UT Fact Sheets (May 2026)
method: Household survey (679,238 households, 716,397 women, 100,977 men); fact sheets print NFHS-6 Urban/Rural/Total and NFHS-5 Total side by side. Total column used.
